title: Higher Education in the Arab Countries
summary: This open access book provides a comprehensive analysis of the evolution of higher education in the Arab world over the last three decades. Through a comparative approach, it examines the diverse socio-political and economic trends across 22 countries. The book explores key themes such as governance, privatization, internationalization, and digitalization, while addressing critical debates on socio-economic development, knowledge creation, and pedagogy. Readers will gain insights into the common challenges and unique developments in higher education within the region. This book offers valuable perspectives for policymakers, educators, and researchers, emphasizing the importance of building an equitable and sustainable higher education system that contributes to socio-economic progress. As the Arab world continues to navigate the complexities of higher education, this volume serves as an essential resource for understanding and fostering future advancements.
